investigations.name: mem-m4-growth-division-propensity

investigations.objective: Can supplied amphiphiles insert into, reshape, and expand a vesicle - and what is its propensity to divide?

investigations.name: mw-s1-wall-rupture-deformability-tradeoff
investigations.title: Across wall-present, wall-attenuated, wall-free-with-cortex, and wall-free-without-cortex arms, where does the cell gain the deformability to enclose a partner without osmotic rupture?
investigations.objective: Across wall-present, wall-attenuated, wall-free-with-cortex, and wall-free-without-cortex arms, where does the cell gain the deformability to enclose a partner without osmotic rupture?

investigations.name: mw-s3-emergent-capability-vs-additive-benefit
investigations.title: Does the partnership create a capability neither free-living partner sustains alone, or only an additive benefit?
investigations.objective: Does the partnership create a capability neither free-living partner sustains alone, or only an additive benefit?

investigations.name: mw-s5-division-sync-and-conflict-suppression
investigations.title: Do division synchronization, copy-number segregation, and conflict suppression make host and partner a single heritable individual?
investigations.objective: Do division synchronization, copy-number segregation, and conflict suppression make host and partner a single heritable individual?

investigations.name: og-autocatalysis-a2
investigations.title: Endogenous Autocatalysis: Does a Self-Amplifying Cycle Form?
investigations.objective: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — across the two representable routes (rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle) — or does it only fix carbon (persistence, A1) without self-amplifying (A2)?
investigations.claim: Under modeled vent conditions, neither tested route forms a self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats its matched null - so endogenous autocatalysis is refuted here. The formose route runs toward condensation, not splitting, so it is feed-driven, not self-amplifying; the reductive-TCA route is autocatalytic in topology but washes out because its closing steps run uphill against vent H2 (the same reason biology uses ferredoxin). This is a limit of the modeled vent redox environment, not a universal impossibility - in a labelled beyond-vent counterfactual (lower barrier, less dilution) the same rTCA topology does meet the self-amplification bar.

investigations.name: og-carbon-fixation
investigations.title: Carbon Fixation: Does H2 Reduce CO2 at the Vent?
investigations.objective: Does H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S catalysts fix carbon and reproduce lab yield benchmarks at the vent — and can the model classes agree on which limitation stops it?
investigations.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction fixes carbon at the vent. Over Fe/Ni/S catalysts the model reproduces the measured yield order (formate ~200 mM >> acetate ~100 uM >> pyruvate ~10 uM) and keeps net organic carbon flowing in a bounded pH-gradient x H2 region; every no-gradient, no-H2, or no-catalyst control collapses it. The result holds - but the two model classes agree on which step limits the rate only 47% of the time (below the 80% bar), so the rate-limiting mechanism is not yet model-robust (a follow-up is planned).

investigations.name: og-ecology
investigations.title: Protocell Ecology: Does Community Function Precede the Cell?
investigations.objective: Is protocell-era chemistry ecological before it is cellular — does a cross-feeding community out-produce the best single lineage (margin causally cross-feeding), does community function precede cell completeness and vanish without exchange — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: Protocell-era chemistry is ecological before it is cellular. A stochastic cross-feeding community out-produces the best single lineage - the margin causally due to cross-feeding, coexistence stabilized not assumed - though it is not more robust than monoculture and low counts materially change outcomes; a connected metacommunity beats an isolated control; and real metabolite exchange makes community function precede cell completeness and vanish without exchange. Qualified.

investigations.name: og-energetics
investigations.title: Proto-Energetics: Can a System Capture and Couple Free Energy?
investigations.objective: Can a primitive chemical system capture geochemical free energy, internalize it under selection, and couple a specified carrier to perform endergonic work — and does any of it improve total throughput, or only persistence/robustness — each tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: A protocell's energetics buy robustness and persistence, not more throughput. A primitive carrier captures geochemical free energy into a transferable store; a compartment internalizes electrochemical work under selection and pays for it within a survival region; and a thioester carrier does useful work through a gradient dip where gradient-only starves - but none of it raises total useful work. Qualified: it buys dip-persistence, not throughput.

investigations.name: og-evolvability
investigations.title: Evolvability and Selection: Is an Inherited Difference Selectable?
investigations.objective: Does a daughter-inherited chemical difference produce a reproducible, selectable fitness difference, and does the population shift under selection rather than drift?
investigations.claim: A daughter-inherited chemical difference makes a reproducible, selectable fitness difference, and the population shifts under selection rather than drifting (parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949; population shift +0.551 vs drift -0.004, against a no-inheritance null). Qualified - shown on the modeled trait space; open-ended chemical novelty beyond it is not.

investigations.name: og-evolvable-lineages
investigations.title: Evolvable Lineages: Can a Granted Individual Evolve?
investigations.objective: Do mechanically defensible daughters carry heritable chemical variation that produces a multi-generation, open-ended evolutionary response - beyond a fixed trait space?
investigations.claim: Given an individual, stochastic partition + variation produce real heritable, selectable adaptation that beats both matched nulls (no-inheritance and shared-feed) and re-tracks a changed environment - but it is bounded fixed-trait selection (heritable variance declines as it converges), not open-ended novelty. Together with og-self-maintaining-individual: individuality is the binding bottleneck; given an individual, evolvability works but is bounded. Qualified.

investigations.name: og-heredity
investigations.title: Chemical Inheritance: Can a Chemical Difference Be Transmitted?
investigations.objective: Can a protocell transmit a heritable chemical difference to its daughters at a feasible cost, without presuming a long high-fidelity RNA template?
investigations.claim: A protocell passes a heritable chemical difference to its daughters at a feasible cost - and heredity need not start from a long, high-fidelity RNA template. Graded head-to-head, inheritance beats a non-heritable control, and compositional/hybrid heredity escapes the Eigen length limit; a cost frontier ranks six mechanisms by heritable bits per joule. Supported. Whether that difference is selectable is tested separately (og-evolvability).

investigations.name: og-independence
investigations.title: Independence from the Vent: Can a Lineage Escape Its Cradle?
investigations.objective: How independent of its geological cradle can a vent-born protocell lineage become — what minimum innovation set lets it persist as external support is withdrawn, which supports can it internalize vs which remain hard dependencies, and is any apparent independence causally attributable to a specific innovation against a matched ablation with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A vent-born lineage reaches graded, attributed independence - not all-or-nothing, and not a free escape. Withdrawing gradient, mineral and feed together picks out a coordinated set {internal pump, importer, heredity}, but across model structures the set is advantageous, not a jointly-necessary unit: only pump+heredity interact positively, the importer is often a net cost, and the one hard dependency is the geological gradient (mineral and feed are freely survivable). Because the feed is lumped and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution map, not a demonstrated escape. Qualified.

investigations.name: og-network-persistence
investigations.title: Network Persistence: Does the Carbon-Fixing Network Sustain Itself?
investigations.objective: Under continuous vent-realistic feed and washout, does the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persist and sustain net carbon throughput as a connected system — and does it do so by endogenous autocatalytic amplification or merely by sustained driven flux — each arm tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: The carbon-fixing network persists - it keeps net carbon flowing as a connected system under vent-realistic feed and washout. But its persistence is driven by the feed, not self-amplifying autocatalysis: in the rule-generated open chemistry (121 species, 413 balanced reactions) a 14-species network persists with no autocatalytic motif, because every C-C-forming route is uphill at the vent feed. Supported - the network persists; endogenous autocatalysis is refuted and tracked separately (og-autocatalysis).

investigations.name: og-network-rescue
investigations.title: Network Rescue: Does Pore Concentration Ignite the Reaction Network?
investigations.objective: Does pore concentration ignite the carbon-fixing reaction network where a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control does not?
investigations.claim: At equal vent-posterior feeds, a concentrating mineral pore ignites the carbon-fixing network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) while a matched well-mixed control stays dead. Spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore causes the productive flux. Supported.

investigations.name: og-nutrient-bottlenecks
investigations.title: Nutrient Bottlenecks: Are Nitrogen and Phosphorus Available with Carbon?
investigations.objective: Do the two non-carbon nutrient bottlenecks clear at the vent — does reduced nitrogen (ammonium) keep pace with carbon fixation, and does reactive phosphorus co-concentrate with carbon rather than precipitate — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: Each non-carbon nutrient bottleneck clears on its own: ammonium is produced and sustained at a viable C:N (the ablation null makes none; nitrogen conserved), and reactive phosphorus is available and co-concentrates with carbon in the pore (open-pore control shows none; phosphorus conserved). Qualified: these are separate successes, not joint C/N/P feasibility - whether C, N and P are available together in compatible forms and the same regime is the harder open bar (carried by og-precursor-pool and og-operating-window).

investigations.name: og-operating-window
investigations.title: Operating Window: Can Pore and Membrane Concentration Rescue the Pool?
investigations.objective: Do the vent, pore, and membrane regimes share a simultaneous operating window, or only a transport-connected sequence of microenvironments?
investigations.claim: Downstream pore-enrichment + membrane retention can lift og-precursor-pool's nanomolar pool to a consumable ~uM - but only in a narrow corner at the upper edge of defensible thermophoresis (high Soret coefficient + high thermal gradient + high DIC together; ~11% of the defensible grid). The canonical mid-point does not clear it. It hinges on the Soret coefficient of the C2-C3 precursors, so measuring that at the vent gradient is the deciding experiment.

investigations.name: og-precursor-pool
investigations.title: Precursor Pool: Can Vent Chemistry Build a Functional Pool?
investigations.objective: Does the vent's reduced-carbon chemistry deliver a functional precursor pool (not just bulk organic flux) that the reaction-network and amphiphile studies can consume?
investigations.claim: The vent's reduced-carbon chemistry delivers a de-novo, atom-balanced, budget-closed functional precursor pool (every control collapses it). But within the defensible DIC window the functional C2+ precursors are thermodynamically capped at sub-micromolar - orders below what downstream chemistry can consume. Qualified.

investigations.name: og-reproduction
investigations.title: Reproduction: Can Growth and Division Build a Lineage?
investigations.objective: How does a self-maintaining protocell reproduce — does metabolism drive growth to a measured-geometry division with viable daughters (not lysis or starvation), building a multi-generation lineage, each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A self-maintaining protocell reproduces by metabolism-coupled growth and division into a lineage. Metabolism drives growth to division at measured geometry with viable daughters (beating a null where growth is decoupled or division imposed); net throughput grows the compartment to division rather than lysis or starvation, mass-conserved; and a dividing individual builds a >=3-generation lineage with volume conserved. Qualified (coarse geometry/budget abstraction).

investigations.name: og-self-compartmentation
investigations.title: Self-Compartmentation: Does Metabolism Build Its Own Boundary?
investigations.objective: How does a vent-born chemical system acquire a self-made boundary and become a self-maintaining protocell — do amphiphiles assemble a retaining-but-not-isolating boundary, does encapsulation pay against a matched equal-feed null, does the integrated compartment self-maintain and beat a matched ablation, and are real fatty-acid vesicles stable — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A vent-born system acquires a self-made boundary and self-maintains as a protocell, the membrane buying persistence rather than throughput. Mixed fatty-acid/alcohol amphiphiles assemble into boundaries in a vent window, giving retention without full isolation and beating single-amphiphile controls; a boundary also forms from the system's own carbon chemistry with a closed matter ledger; encapsulation pays against an equal-feed null on persistence and access (not throughput), within a window; and real fatty-acid (Martini-3) vesicles are stable across C10-C16 while a fully-charged null micellises. Qualified.

investigations.name: og-self-maintaining-individual
investigations.title: Self-Maintaining Individuality: Does the Chemistry–Boundary Loop Close?
investigations.objective: Does the coupled chemistry-and-boundary system maintain itself - chemistry making the boundary that in turn sustains the chemistry - under perturbation, without a built-in production or retention gain?
investigations.claim: The coupled chemistry-and-boundary system does not maintain itself endogenously under defensible vent conditions: even at the favorable corner, the chemistry's acetate yields an amphiphile pool ~4 orders below the concentration needed to form a membrane (~7 orders below at the canonical point), so no boundary forms without assuming one, and reciprocal maintenance cannot close - across all three ablations. A scoped refutation of endogenous closure; the broader question of how individuality emerges stays open.

investigations.name: og-spatial-concentration
investigations.title: Spatial Concentration: Does a Pore Enrich a Dilute Feed?
investigations.objective: Does a serpentinite pore concentrate a dilute vent feed above the dilution/retention threshold, and does the chemically-necessary multi-solute set co-localize or fractionate?
investigations.claim: A serpentinite pore concentrates a dilute vent feed above the dilution/retention threshold (Peclet 18.4), while an open-pore control washes through. But the eight chemically-required solutes fractionate (Soret-driven, co-localization ~0.18) rather than gathering together - a possible spatial incompatibility. Supported, bounded.

investigations.name: og-vent-environment
investigations.title: The Vent Environment: Does It Supply a Viable Feed?
investigations.objective: Does a serpentinizing alkaline vent hold its empirical (Lost City) window across the operating grid and supply, in a calibrated posterior, the feed downstream chemistry needs?
investigations.claim: An alkaline hydrothermal vent stays in its real-world Lost City window (40-91 C, pH 9-10.8, H2 flowing) across ~80% of the conditions tested. Within that window, every empirically supported vent state supplies what downstream carbon fixation needs - a bounded, calibrated feed, not a claim about life's origin.

investigations.name: og-vent-interface
investigations.title: The Mineral Interface: Does It Sustain Flux Within a DIC Window?
investigations.objective: Does the evolving mineral-water interface sustain its H2 / inorganic-carbon flux and pH/redox gradient as minerals evolve, and where does the DIC window bound it?
investigations.claim: The evolving mineral interface delivers reduced-carbon chemistry only inside a narrow DIC window - under full redox equilibrium, DIC is drawn down before free H2 appears, so the usable window is a thin two-regime band. Qualified: this DIC cliff is the realized result; sustained-flux supply decay and the coupled ledger over longer timescales are planned, not yet run.

investigations.name: og-vent-specificity
investigations.title: Vent Specificity: Are the Gates Vent-Specific or Generic?
investigations.objective: Do the campaign's discriminating gates detect the serpentinizing alkaline vent specifically, or would any generic non-equilibrium drive pass them?
investigations.claim: Strip all three vent features at once (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst, no pore concentration) and the generic drive fails all five discriminating gates on the same composites the vent passes - so the campaign's gates are not just generic non-equilibrium detectors, and the generic-nonequilibrium null is correctly rejected. Caveat: this is a lumped, all-features-off contrast - it does not credit any single feature, and full specificity against competing realistic environments is not demonstrated yet (that factorial and the competing-environments study are planned).

investigations.name: s01-formation
investigations.title: Collective formation
investigations.objective: Which adhesion, reproductive, and ecological regimes create persistent collectives rather than transient aggregates? (Q1)
investigations.claim: Clonal incomplete separation with reversible adhesion produces a persistent group life cycle (group fraction 0.67) that a no-adhesion null does not (0.01). This shows group formation - it says nothing yet about fitness.

investigations.name: s02-ecological-selection
investigations.title: Ecological selection
investigations.objective: Can size-dependent predation and settling reward group formation without added physiology? (Q1)
investigations.claim: Under size-dependent predation/settling, groups gain a fitness advantage over unicells (+0.15); with adhesion alone and no ecology the advantage vanishes (-0.00). So it is ecological selection, not adhesion itself, that confers the group-level advantage.

investigations.name: s03-transport-limits
investigations.title: Transport limits
investigations.objective: How do oxygen, nutrients, cell shape, packing and geometry limit collective size? (Q2)
investigations.claim: Oxygen/transport bounds the advantage to an optimal intermediate size: small groups (size 3.7) keep a positive advantage (+0.12) while large groups (size 17) lose it (-0.21). The advantage is not monotonic in size - it tracks the transport regime.

investigations.name: s04-morphomechanics
investigations.title: Morphomechanics
investigations.objective: How do cell aspect ratio, branch topology, packing and bond strength set collective toughness and propagule size? (Q2)
investigations.claim: Cell adhesion (homotypic contact energy) sets collective toughness: under growth-driven stress a clonal CPM cluster stays one cohesive propagule at strong adhesion and fractures into several at weak adhesion. Unproven until the adhesion x seed sweep is graded; aspect ratio, branch topology, and cross-backend agreement are not tested here.

investigations.name: s05-differentiation
investigations.title: Cell-state differentiation
investigations.objective: Can environmental gradients create stable cell-state differentiation without a dedicated developmental program? (Q4, Q3)
investigations.claim: In a 2D CPM world with an O2 gradient, O2-keyed germ/soma specialization (fixed stemness threshold) improves net viable growth out-of-sample on held-out environment B: decisively over a random-fate null and modestly (~5%) over a no-fate null, in a moderate-O2 regime. The benefit vanishes when O2 is plentiful and degrades when it is very scarce - a transient 40-update window, one CPM backend.

investigations.name: s06-individuality
investigations.title: Evolutionary individuality
investigations.objective: Does generational group selection on a heritable adhesion trait produce a response that requires clonal group structure (evolutionary individuality)? (Q5)
investigations.claim: Clonal group-level selection on a heritable adhesion set-point produces a multi-generation response: mean adhesion rises +0.22 on held-out seeds over 6 generations, beating the selection-off drift null and reaching the highest cohesion (toughness ~0.93). Clonality is needed for full trait transmission (heritability 1.0 clonal vs 0.5 mixed). Qualified: the clean selection-vs-drift margin is on the training seeds; on held-out seeds the drift null itself drifts up (~+0.10, a boundary artifact), narrowing the held-out margin to +0.12. Heritability is structural (set by the clonal/mixed encoding), not emergent - the emergent result is the selection response.

investigations.name: s1-metabolic-partnership
investigations.title: S1 — Metabolic partnership: can an archaeal-bacterial pair gain fitness from exchange?
investigations.objective: Can plausible archaeal-bacterial pairs gain fitness from metabolite exchange, and under which redox and substrate regimes? Does the predicted mutualism survive mass-balance and electron-donor/acceptor feasibility audits and alternative reconstructions?
investigations.claim: An archaeal-bacterial partnership can become mutually beneficial under restricted redox and substrate conditions: a connected cross-feeding community develops functional redundancy that an isolated (no-exchange) control does not, on mass-balanced exchange. But the benefit is not necessarily stable or obligate, and it disappears outside the feasible regime.

investigations.name: s2-ecology-to-proximity
investigations.title: S2 — Ecology to proximity: when does cross-feeding select for persistent contact?
investigations.objective: When do cross-feeding benefits select for persistent proximity rather than independent coexistence? Does the predicted selection for proximity disappear under high diffusion / well-mixed conditions?
investigations.claim: Selection can favor sustained contact. In spatially structured (low-diffusion) settings the S1 cross-feeding flux is strongly distance-dependent - close (mixed) partners sustain the exchange, distant (segregated) ones lose it - a precondition for intimate symbiosis. The advantage vanishes when well-mixed, so proximity selection depends on spatial structure.

investigations.name: s3-protrusions-to-enclosure
investigations.title: S3 — Protrusions to enclosure: can protrusion mechanics reach stable wrapping?
investigations.objective: Can observed archaeal protrusion mechanics plausibly transition from contact to stable wrapping / engulfment, within membrane area, bending-cost, and timescale budgets? Morphology alone cannot demonstrate engulfment.
investigations.claim: Physical enclosure is a separate hurdle from metabolic benefit. Under favorable area and adhesion budgets, protrusion mechanics can reach stable wrapping across most of the partner-size range - but a beneficial symbiosis does not imply the ability to engulf, and enclosure fails without wrapping or when adhesion cannot pay the bending cost.

investigations.name: s4-compartmental-energetic-coupling
investigations.title: S4 — Compartmental energetic coupling: does internalization pay for itself?
investigations.objective: Does internalization increase net fitness given ATP production, transport losses, upkeep, and host-symbiont conflict — and in which parameter regimes is internalization actually harmful?
investigations.claim: An enclosed partner gains organelle-like function only under restricted conditions: internalizing gradient generation pays off and the population persists only where the pump is efficient. Where the pump is weak, internalization cannot cover the membrane cost and the population collapses.

investigations.name: s5-symbiont-to-organelle
investigations.title: S5 — From symbiont to organelle: when does integration become heritable?
investigations.objective: Which routes to inheritance lead to stable vertical transmission and a persistent lineage? Distinguish mere within-host survival from high-fidelity vertical transmission over many generations.
investigations.claim: Integration becomes heritable and coordinated - a new evolutionary individual - only once vertical-transmission fidelity crosses the Eigen error threshold; above it, the inherited phenotype persists with function across generations. Below threshold the lineage hits the error catastrophe and collapses; a non-heritable mechanism transmits nothing.

investigations.name: study-bidirectional-syntrophy
investigations.title: Does obligate bidirectional syntrophy add a constraint beyond proximity?
investigations.objective: The syntrophy/hydrogen hypotheses are obligate two-metabolite mutualisms. Does Liebig-limited reciprocal exchange require metabolic BALANCE, not just contact?

investigations.name: study-contact-to-enclosure-coupling
investigations.title: Do the same conditions that select proximity also permit enclosure?
investigations.objective: Do the same conditions that select proximity also permit enclosure?

investigations.name: study-enclosure-mechanics
investigations.title: Can selected contact transition to stable enclosure under physical constraints?
investigations.objective: Can selected contact transition to stable enclosure under physical constraints?

investigations.name: study-selection-for-proximity
investigations.title: Does exchange increase the fitness of contact-seeking phenotypes?
investigations.objective: Does exchange increase the fitness of contact-seeking phenotypes?

investigations.name: study-spatial-exchange-proximity
investigations.title: Does contact mechanistically confer an exchange advantage?
investigations.objective: M1 assumes contact scales exchange access. Under explicit diffusion, is realised metabolite exchange strongly proximity-dependent, or well-mixed (premise invalid)?

investigations.name: study-vertical-transmission-stability
investigations.title: Is the established endosymbiosis evolutionarily stable?
investigations.objective: Once contact+enclosure establish the symbiosis (M3), is the symbiont heritably retained across generations, or does conflict/partner-loss decay it?
